text:
Kai Wong: Quick q — offer for SDE2 (EU) is approved but candidate flagged "needs residency docs" before payroll. We also need to confirm comp band parity vs US offer (candidate asked for local-market adjustment). Start date penciled May 4. Who should I loop in for a fast comp-band exception or geo-adjust?
Emma R.: tagging comp-committee? /cc @Ana Gupta for band guidance. do we have a precedent for eu-localization + sign-on? :thinking_face:
Ana Gupta: Hi — we have a policy for geo parity in EMEA but it depends on level and cost-of-living. For SDE2, usually band M3 vs M2 in some markets. Send me the candidate's city + original offer numbers.
Kai Wong: Candidate in Lisbon, base was presented as $130k USD equivalent. They asked if we can match local median (~€70k). Offer sheet attached in Greenhouse.
Linus Meyer: For Lisbon we typically apply a localized band at M3 with a cost-of-living adj ~ -8% from USD-ish comp. If candidate asked specifically, we can propose localized base + local benefits. Need finance signoff for payroll sizing.
Kai Wong: OK. Can someone route to finance for commit? I can hold start date back a week if needed.
Jeremy-Finance: I can take this — sending the payroll sizing calc now. Quick note: cross-border hires need tax-equalization option flagged if they retain US tax residency. Otherwise normal local payroll.
People Ops Bot: Required checklist reminder: residency doc, right-to-work, local bank details, benefits enrollment windows (first 30 days), and local tax form. See: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/hiring/eu-checklist
Emma R.: Ana, can you recommend proposed band text for the offer addendum (localized comp + benefits summary) so we can present two options to candidate?
Ana Gupta: Suggested addendum snippet: "Local compensation: base = €70,000, local benefits per Portugal policy (health plan X, meal vouchers Y), sign-on = one-time €5,000, paid first payroll". Approve this for committee review.
Kai Wong: Thanks — I will upload the addendum to Greenhouse and mark start date tentative May 11 till we confirm payroll. Routing to @Jeremy-Finance and comp-committee now.
Emma R.: @Jeremy-Finance once you confirm sizing, I'll open a short exception route: /comp-exception create 2834506789 "Portugal-localize M3" — will tag Ana and Jeremy.
Jeremy-Finance: Got it. Expecting ping back within 24 hrs. If payroll sizing requires increase >10% vs USD offer, we'll need exec signoff.
Linus Meyer: Also flag benefits waiting period — candidate will enroll within 30 days but some perks (relocation, remote allowance) may need separate approvals.
Kai Wong: Great — thanks team. I'll pause final acceptance until we have band confirmation. :thumbsup:
